lull.calibrate: Sit comfortably. Face the lamp. Just breathe.
lull.weak: I can't read you well. A lamp in front of your face would help.
lull.breathe: Breathe. Holding it won't help you here.
lull.hide: It's coming. Hide, and breathe slowly.
lull.encounter: Stay still. Slow breaths. Follow my wings.
lull.survived: It's gone. Well done. Let your breathing settle.
lull.paused: It waits. It can't hear you while I can't see you.
lull.finale: The lock listens for calm. Three slow, even breaths.
lull.corridor: No cover out here. Don't linger.
lull.tape: Stay by the reel while it plays.
lull.allTapes: That's all three tapes. Now the fuse.
lull.fuse: Take it to the breaker in the corridor.
lull.door: Power's back. The blast door is at the end of the corridor.

control.title: Reel 14 · Dr. I. Vane · 2 March 1987
lines: Kestrel Seven is quiet enough now that the array picks up the staff from two floors away.
Footfalls. Coughs. We can tell people apart by their heartbeats.
Today the array heard a fifth heartbeat in a room with four people in it.
Maintenance found nothing. I have asked them to check again.

archive.title: Reel 22 · Dr. I. Vane · 9 April 1987
lines: It isn't in the rooms. It's in the recordings. It moves between the reels.
It doesn't see. We tested that. Lights, mirrors, nothing.
But drop your pen in the far wing and it turns, every horn at once.
Sit still and breathe slowly, and it walks straight past you. I have done it twice.

boiler.title: Reel 31 · Dr. I. Vane · undated
lines: Everyone else has gone. I pulled the fuse so the blast door can't open for it.
The lock is keyed to a calm signature. Slow, even breaths. We built it as a joke.
It can't fake calm. It has never been calm.
If you can hear this, put the fuse back, and breathe. Please, just breathe.
